# HStatCard

> A quiet overview metric with tabular numbers, an icon, and a supporting label.

[Start with the Hearth UI agent index](../../../llms.txt). This reference describes repository source; package.json version: 0.2.0. Match it to the source/release you are using.

## Identity

- Vue export: `HStatCard` from `@samishal1998/hearth-ui`.
- Custom element: `<hearth-stat-card>`.
- Individual constructor: `HearthStatCardElement` from `@samishal1998/hearth-ui/elements`.
- Category: Surfaces.
- [Implementation](https://github.com/samishal1998/hearth-ui/blob/main/src/components/HStatCard.vue).

## Choose and use it correctly

- value is a string or number. Supply already formatted values where formatting matters.
- Use concise labels and optional detail for a denominator or supporting context; the component does not calculate the metric.

## Public API

label: string · value: string | number · detail, icon: string · tone: Tone

A `?` marks optional source props. A prop with a default may be omitted even when the source type is required. Internal `formDisabled` and `control-sync` plumbing is excluded below; do not use it in application code.

```ts
type Props = {
    label: string;
    value: string | number;
    detail?: string;
    icon?: string;
    tone?: Tone;
};
```

### Defaults

```ts
{ icon: "apps", tone: "accent" }
```

### Events

None

Vue-emitted custom-element events expose arguments as `event.detail`, an array. Listen directly on the element. Native DOM events such as `click` keep their normal payloads.

### Slots

None

Vue uses `<template #slotName>`; custom elements use `<div slot="slotName">`. Custom elements do not support Vue scoped slots.

### CSS parts

base, icon, value, label

Use `hearth-stat-card::part(part-name)` for an exposed part, or inherited `--h-*` tokens for system-level styling. Native Vue components use the shared stylesheet and `h-*` classes.

## Supporting types

```ts
export type Tone = "neutral" | "accent" | "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "info";
```

## Vue example

```vue
<script setup lang="ts">
import { HStatCard } from '@samishal1998/hearth-ui';
import '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/styles.css';

</script>

<template>
  <HStatCard label="Healthy apps" :value="8" detail="/ 10" icon="health" tone="success" />
</template>
```

## Web-component example

Provide a mount point (use a `form` instead of `div` when demonstrating field submission):

```html
<div id="example"></div>
```

The following is bundler-based ESM. For raw HTML, load `dist/themes.css` with a stylesheet link and import `registerElements` from `./dist/elements/index.js` instead. Set array/object properties before connection when they should become reset defaults.

```js
import { registerElements } from '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/elements';
import '@samishal1998/hearth-ui/themes.css';
registerElements();

const mount = document.querySelector('#example');
const element = document.createElement('hearth-stat-card');
Object.assign(element, {
  "label": "Healthy apps",
  "value": 8,
  "detail": "/ 10",
  "icon": "health",
  "tone": "success"
});
mount.append(element);
```
